The Healthcare Cost of Air Pollution: Evidence from the World's Largest Payment Network
abstract: Using the universe of credit-and debit-card transactions in China during 2013-2015, this paper provides the first nationwide analysis of the healthcare cost of PM2.5.We leverage spatial spillovers of PM2.5 from long-range transport for exogenous variation in local pollution and employ a flexible distributed lag model to capture semiparametrically the dynamic response of pollution exposure. Our analysis shows significant impacts of PM2.5 on healthcare spending in both the short and medium terms.A 10 mg/m3 decrease in PM2.5 would reduce annual healthcare spending by more than $9.2 billion, about 1.5% of China's annual healthcare expenditure.
abstract_zh: 利用2013–2015年中国全部信用卡和借记卡交易数据，本文首次在全国范围内分析了PM2.5的医疗成本。我们利用PM2.5远距离输送产生的空间溢出效应，获得地方污染的外生变异，并采用灵活的分布滞后模型，以半参数方式刻画污染暴露的动态响应。我们的分析表明，PM2.5在短期和中期都对医疗支出有显著影响。PM2.5每降低10 mg/m³，每年可减少医疗支出90亿美元以上，约占中国年度医疗支出的1.5%。

From Fog to Smog: the Value of Pollution Information
abstract: During 2013-2014, China launched a nationwide, real-time air quality monitoring and disclosure program, a watershed moment in the history of its environmental regulations. We present the first empirical analysis of this natural experiment by exploiting its staggered implementation across cities. The program has transformed the landscape of China's environmental protection, substantially expanded public access to pollution information, and dramatically increased households' awareness about pollution issues. These transformations, in turn, triggered a cascade of household behavioral changes, including increases in online searches for pollution-related topics, adjustments in day-to-day consumption patterns to avoid pollution exposure, and higher willingness to pay for housing in less polluted areas. As a result of both short- and long-term behavioral changes, the program significantly reduced the mortality impact of air pollution. Conservative estimates suggest that health benefits are at least one order of magnitude larger than the costs of the program and associated avoidance behaviors combined. Our findings highlight considerable benefits from improving access to pollution information in developing countries, many of which are experiencing the world's worst air pollution but do not systematically collect or disseminate pollution information.
abstract_zh: 2013年至2014年间，中国启动了全国性的实时空气质量监测与信息披露计划，这是其环境监管史上的分水岭。我们利用该计划在各城市交错实施的特点，首次对这一自然实验进行了实证分析。该计划改变了中国环境保护的面貌，大幅扩展了公众获取污染信息的渠道，并显著提高了家庭对污染问题的认识。这些转变进而引发了一系列家庭行为变化，包括与污染相关主题的网络搜索量增加、为避免污染暴露而调整日常消费模式，以及对于在污染较轻地区购房的支付意愿提高。受短期与长期行为变化的共同影响，该计划显著降低了空气污染的死亡率影响。保守估计表明，其健康效益至少比该计划及相关规避行为的总成本大一个数量级。我们的发现凸显了在发展中国家改善污染信息获取所具有的可观效益，许多发展中国家正经历着世界上最严重的空气污染，却并未系统地收集或发布污染信息。

Policies for Electrifying the Light-Duty Vehicle Fleet in the United States
abstract: Decarbonization of light-duty vehicles (LDVs) in the United States is an important policy priority. We investigate the roles of the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act and the Inflation Reduction Act in accelerating the transition of LDVs to electric vehicles. We additionally consider alternate allocations of government funds for subsidized construction of charging stations and refundable tax credits for electric vehicles. We find that charging station subsidies are extremely effective as measured by impact for a given fiscal expenditure. All of the policies we consider have estimated costs below the most recent estimate of the social cost of carbon.
abstract_zh: 美国轻型汽车（LDVs）的脱碳是一项重要的政策优先事项。我们考察了《基础设施投资和就业法案》与《通胀削减法案》在加速轻型汽车向电动汽车转型方面的作用。我们还考虑了政府资金的其他分配方式，包括对充电站建设的补贴以及对电动汽车的可退还税收抵免。我们发现，以单位财政支出所产生的影响来衡量，充电站补贴的效果极为显著。我们所考虑的所有政策，其估计成本均低于社会碳成本的最新估计值。

The Cost of Greening Stimulus: A Dynamic Discrete Analysis of Vehicle Scrappage Programs
abstract: During the Great Recession, many countries adopted stimulus programs designed to achieve two goals: to stimulate economic activity in lagging durable goods sectors, and to protect or enhance environmental quality. Advocates of such programs contend that the environmental benefits are co-benefits of economic stimulus. This paper investigates the potential tradeoff between the stimulus and environmental objectives in the context of the popular U.S. Cash-for-Clunkers (CFC) vehicle scrappage program. We develop and estimate a dynamic discrete choice model of vehicle ownership, and conduct counterfactual analysis comparing the implemented policy with alternative policy designs. Results show that design elements to achieve environmental benefits significantly limit the program's impact on demand stimulus. The cost of demand stimulus after netting out environmental benefits under the program could be 25 percent higher in terms of vehicle sales and 64 percent higher in terms of consumer spending than alternative policy designs without explicitly targeting the environmental objective. Our findings serve as a cautionary tale for green stimulus proposals that aim to address both the economic crisis from the COVID-19 pandemic and climate change.
abstract_zh: 在大衰退期间，许多国家推出了刺激计划，旨在实现两个目标：刺激落后的耐用消费品部门的经济活动，以及保护或改善环境质量。此类计划的倡导者认为，环境效益是经济刺激的协同效益。本文以美国广受欢迎的“以旧换新”（Cash-for-Clunkers，CFC）汽车报废计划为背景，考察刺激目标与环境目标之间的潜在权衡。我们构建并估计了一个车辆持有的动态离散选择模型，并进行反事实分析，将实际实施的政策与其他政策设计进行比较。结果表明，为实现环境效益而设计的政策要素显著限制了该计划对需求刺激的效果。在扣除该计划的环境效益之后，与未明确针对环境目标的其他政策设计相比，需求刺激的成本在汽车销量方面可能高出25%，在消费者支出方面可能高出64%。我们的发现为那些旨在同时应对COVID-19疫情经济危机与气候变化的绿色刺激提案敲响了警钟。

title: The Role of Government in the Market for Electric Vehicles: Evidence from China
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
abstract: To promote the development and diffusion of electric vehicles, central and local governments in many countries have adopted various incentive programs. This study examines the policy and market drivers behind the rapid development of the electric vehicle market in China, by far the largest one in the world. The analysis is based on the most comprehensive data on electric vehicle sales, local and central government incentive programs, and charging stations in 150 cities from 2015 to 2018. The study addresses the potential endogeneity of key variables, such as local policies and charging infrastructure, using the border regression design and instrumental variable method. The analysis shows that central and local subsidies accounted for over half of the electric vehicles sold during the data period. Investment in charging infrastructure is much more cost-effective than consumer purchase subsidies. In addition, the policy that merely provided electric vehicles a distinctively license plate was strikingly effective. These findings demonstrate the varying efficacy across policy instruments and highlight the critical role of government in promoting fuel-saving technologies.
abstract_zh: 为促进电动汽车的发展与普及，许多国家的中央政府和地方政府都采取了各种激励计划。本研究考察了中国电动汽车市场迅速发展背后的政策与市场驱动因素，中国是世界上规模最大的电动汽车市场。分析基于2015至2018年间150个城市中关于电动汽车销售、地方及中央政府激励计划以及充电站的最为全面的数据。研究采用边界回归设计和工具变量法，处理地方政策与充电基础设施等关键变量的内生性问题。分析表明，在数据期间，中央和地方补贴占所售电动汽车的一半以上。与消费者购车补贴相比，充电基础设施投资的成本效益要高得多。此外，仅为电动汽车提供专属车牌的政策效果显著。这些发现表明不同政策工具的效力存在差异，并凸显了政府在推广节油技术方面的关键作用。

title: China's War on Pollution: Evidence from the First Five Years
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: The decade from 2010 to 2019 marked a significant turning point in China’s history of environmental regulation and pollution. This article describes the recent trends in air and water quality, with a focus on the five years since China declared a “war on pollution” in 2014. It summarizes the emerging literature that has taken advantage of accompanying improvements in data availability and accuracy to document sharp improvements in environmental quality, especially local air pollution, and understand their social, economic, and health consequences.
abstract_zh: 2010年至2019年的十年，是中国环境规制与污染历史上的重要转折点。本文描述了近期空气和水质的变化趋势，重点关注中国于2014年宣布“向污染宣战”以来的五年。文章总结了一批新兴文献，这些文献利用数据可得性和准确性的同步提升，记录了环境质量（尤其是当地空气污染）的显著改善，并考察了其社会、经济和健康后果。

The Marginal Cost of Traffic Congestion: Evidence from a Natural Experiment in Beijing

Transportation and the Environment in Developing Countries
abstract: In urban areas around the world, increasing motorization and growing travel demand make the urban transportation sector an ever-greater contributor to local air pollution and greenhouse gas emissions. The situation is particularly acute in developing countries, where growing metropolitan regions suffer some of the world's highest levels of air pollution. Policies that seek to develop and manage this transportation sector—both to meet rising demand linked to economic growth and to safeguard the environment and human health—have had strikingly different results, with some inadvertently exacerbating the traffic and pollution they seek to mitigate. This review summarizes findings in the recent literature on the impacts of a host of urban transportation policies used in both developed- and developing-country settings. The article identifies research challenges and future areas of study regarding transportation policies, which can have important, long-lasting impacts on urban life and global climate change.
abstract_zh: 在世界各地的城市地区，机动化程度的提高和出行需求的增长，使城市交通部门对地方空气污染和温室气体排放的贡献日益增大。这一状况在发展中国家尤为严峻，其快速增长的大都市区遭受着世界上最高水平的空气污染。旨在发展和管理这一交通部门的政策——既要满足与经济增长相关的日益增长的需求，又要保护环境和人类健康——其结果截然不同，有些政策反而无意中加剧了其本意要缓解的交通拥堵和污染。本文综述了近期文献中关于发达国家和发展中国家所采用的多种城市交通政策影响的研究发现。文章指出了关于交通政策的研究挑战和未来研究方向，这些政策可能对城市生活和全球气候变化产生重要且持久的影响。

title: Brand Names and Consumer Demand: Evidence from China's Automobile Market
Does Subway Expansion Improve Air Quality?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Major cities in China and many other fast-growing economies are expanding their subway systems in order to address worsening air pollution and traffic congestion. This paper quantifies the impact of subway expansion on air quality by leveraging fine-scale air quality data and the rapid build-out of 14 new subway lines and 252 stations in Beijing from 2008 to 2016. Our main empirical framework examines how the density of the subway network affects air quality across different locations in the city during this period. To address the potential endogenous location of subway stations, we construct an instrument based on historical subway planning, long before air pollution and traffic congestion were of concern. Our analysis shows that an increase in subway density by one standard deviation improves air quality by two percent and the result is robust to a variety of alternative specifications including the distance-based difference-in-differences method. The total discounted health benefit during a 20-year period from reduced mortality and morbidity as a result of 14 new subway lines amounts to $1.0–3.1 billion, or only 1.4–4.4 percent of the total construction and operating cost.
abstract_zh: 中国及许多其他快速增长经济体的主要城市正在扩建地铁系统，以应对日益恶化的空气污染和交通拥堵。本文利用精细尺度的空气质量数据，以及2008至2016年间北京新建14条地铁线路和252座车站的快速建设过程，量化了地铁扩建对空气质量的影响。我们的主要实证框架考察了在此期间，地铁网络密度如何影响城市不同地点的空气质量。为应对地铁站点位置可能存在的内生性，我们基于历史地铁规划构建了工具变量，而这些规划远早于空气污染和交通拥堵成为关注问题的时期。分析表明，地铁密度每增加一个标准差，空气质量改善2%，且该结果在包括基于距离的双重差分法在内的多种替代设定下均保持稳健。新建14条地铁线路所减少的死亡率和发病率在20年间带来的折现健康效益总额为10亿至31亿美元，仅占建设和运营总成本的1.4%至4.4%。

title: Better Lucky than Rich? Welfare Analysis of Vehicle License Allocations in Beijing and Shanghai
abstract: Economists often favor market-based mechanisms (e.g., auction) over non-market based mechanisms (e.g., lottery) for allocating scarce public resources on grounds of economic efficiency and revenue generation. When the usage of the resources in question generates negative externalities that are increasing in willingness-to-pay (WTP), the welfare comparison can become ambiguous. Both types of mechanisms are being used in China's major cities to distribute limited vehicle licenses as a measure to combat worsening traffic congestion and urban pollution. While Beijing employs non-transferable lotteries, Shanghai uses an auction system. This paper empirically quantifies the welfare consequences of the two mechanisms by taking into account both allocation efficiency and automobile externalities post-allocation. Our analysis shows that different allocation mechanisms lead to dramatic differences in social welfare. Although the lottery system in Beijing has a large advantage in reducing externalities from automobile use than a uniform price auction, the advantage is offset by the significant welfare loss from misallocation. The lottery system forewent nearly 36 billion RMB (or $6 billion) in social welfare in Beijing in 2012 alone. A uniform-price auction would have generated 21.6 billion RMB to Beijing municipal government, more than covering all the subsidies to the local public transit system.
abstract_zh: 出于经济效率和财政收入的考虑，经济学家通常更倾向于以市场机制（如拍卖）而非非市场机制（如抽签）来分配稀缺的公共资源。然而，当所涉资源的使用产生的负外部性随支付意愿（WTP）递增时，福利比较可能变得模糊。中国主要城市正在采用两种机制来分配有限的车辆牌照，以此作为应对日益严重的交通拥堵和城市污染的措施。北京采用不可转让的抽签制度，上海则采用拍卖制度。本文通过同时考虑分配效率和分配后的汽车外部性，对两种机制的福利后果进行了实证量化。分析表明，不同的分配机制会导致社会福利的巨大差异。尽管北京的抽签制度在减少汽车使用外部性方面比统一价格拍卖具有较大优势，但这一优势被资源错配造成的显著福利损失所抵消。仅2012年，北京的抽签制度就使社会福利损失近360亿元人民币（约合60亿美元）。统一价格拍卖本可为北京市政府带来216亿元人民币的收入，足以覆盖对当地公共交通系统的全部补贴。

Assessing the Role of Renewable Energy Policies in Landfill Gas to Energy Projects
abstract: Methane (CH4) is the second most prevalent greenhouse gas and has a global warming potential at least 28 times as high as Carbon Dioxide (CO2). In the United States, Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) landfills are reported to be the third-largest source of human-made methane emissions, responsible for 18% of methane emissions in 2011. Capturing landfill gas (LFG) for use as an energy source for electricity or heat produces alternative energy as well as environmental benefits. A host of federal and state policies encourage the development of landfill gas to energy (LFGE) projects. This research provides the first systematic economic assessment of the role of these policies on adoption decisions. Results suggest that Renewable Portfolio Standards and investment tax credits have contributed to the development of these projects, accounting for 13 of 277 projects during our data period from 1991 to 2010. These policy-induced projects lead to 12.5 MMTCO2e reductions in greenhouse gas emissions and a net benefit of $52.59 million.
abstract_zh: 甲烷（CH4）是第二大最常见的温室气体，其全球增温潜势至少是二氧化碳（CO2）的28倍。据报告，在美国，城市固体废弃物（MSW）填埋场是人为甲烷排放的第三大来源，2011年占甲烷排放量的18%。将填埋气（LFG）捕集并用作发电或供热的能源，既能产生替代能源，又能带来环境效益。联邦和州政府的一系列政策鼓励发展填埋气发电（LFGE）项目。本研究首次对这些政策在项目采纳决策中的作用进行了系统的经济评估。结果表明，可再生能源配额制和投资税收抵免促进了这些项目的发展，在1991至2010年的数据期间内，共计促成了277个项目中的13个。这些政策诱致的项目使温室气体排放减少了1,250万吨二氧化碳当量（MMTCO2e），并带来5,259万美元的净收益。

title: Public Bus Procurement: The Role of Regulation, Energy Prices and Federal Subsidies
abstract: The U.S. public transit system represents a multi-billion dollar industry that provides essential transit services to millions of urban residents. We study the market for new transit buses that features a set of non-profit transit agencies purchasing buses primarily from a few domestic bus makers. Unlike private vehicles, the fuel economy of public buses is irresponsive to fuel price changes. To understand this finding, we build a model of bus fleet management decisions of local transit agencies that yields testable hypotheses. Our empirical analysis of bus fleet turnover and capital investment suggests that transit agencies: (1) do not respond to energy prices in either their scrappage or purchase decisions;(2) respond to environmental regulations by scrapping diesel buses earlier and switch to natural gas buses; (3) prefer purchasing buses from manufacturers whose assembly plants are located in the same state; (4) exhibit significant brand loyalty or lock-in effects; (5) favor domestically produced buses when they have access to more federal funding.
abstract_zh: 美国公共交通系统是一个价值数十亿美元的产业，为数百万城市居民提供基本的交通服务。我们研究了新型公交车市场，该市场的特点是一批非营利性公交机构主要向少数几家国内客车制造商采购车辆。与私家车不同，公交车的燃油经济性对燃油价格变化不敏感。为理解这一发现，我们构建了一个地方公交机构车队管理决策模型，并由此得出可检验的假设。我们对公交车队更新和资本投资的实证分析表明，公交机构：（1）在报废或采购决策中均不对能源价格作出反应；（2）通过更早报废柴油公交车并转而采购天然气公交车来应对环境法规；（3）倾向于从装配厂位于同一州的制造商处采购车辆；（4）表现出显著的品牌忠诚或锁定效应；（5）当可获得更多联邦资金时，更倾向于采购国产公交车。

title: The Price Evolution of China's Automobile Market
A New Look at Residential Electricity Demand Using Household Expenditure Data
abstract: Many electricity demand estimates have been obtained based on the assumption that consumers optimize with respect to known marginal prices, but increasing empirical evidence suggests that consumers are more likely to respond to average prices. Under this assumption, this paper develops a new strategy based on Generalized Method of Moments to estimate household electricity demand. Our demand estimation approach uses publicly available expenditure data and utility-level consumption data from several major U.S. cities, complementing studies that use individual billing data which are richer yet often proprietary. We estimate the price elasticity near -0.50, which is at the upper end (in magnitude) among the estimates from previous studies. This could have important implications for policy analysis such as those on climate policies that may affect electricity prices.
abstract_zh: 许多电力需求估计是基于消费者会根据已知边际价格进行优化这一假设而得出的，但越来越多的实证证据表明，消费者更可能对平均价格作出反应。在此假设下，本文提出了一种基于广义矩估计（GMM）的新策略来估计家庭电力需求。我们的需求估计方法使用了公开可得的支出数据，以及美国若干主要城市的公用事业层面用电数据，对使用个人账单数据（信息更丰富但往往属于私有）的研究形成了补充。我们估计的价格弹性接近-0.50，就绝对值而言，处于以往研究估计结果的较高端。这对于政策分析可能具有重要意义，例如可能影响电价的气候政策分析。

title: Gasoline Taxes and Consumer Behavior
abstract: Gasoline taxes can be employed to correct externalities from automobile use and to raise government revenue. Our understanding of the optimal gasoline tax and the efficacy of existing taxes is largely based on empirical analysis of consumer responses to gasoline price changes. In this paper, we examine directly how gasoline taxes affect gasoline consumption as distinct from tax-inclusive retail gasoline prices. We find robust evidence that consumers respond more strongly to gasoline tax changes under a variety of model specifications. We discuss two potential reasons for our main findings as well as their implications. (JEL D12, H21, H25, H31, L71, Q35)
abstract_zh: 汽油税既可用于矫正汽车使用所产生的外部性，也可用于增加政府收入。我们对最优汽油税以及现行税收效力的理解，很大程度上基于对消费者对汽油价格变动反应的实证分析。在本文中，我们直接考察汽油税如何影响汽油消费，并将其与含税零售汽油价格的影响区分开来。我们发现，在多种模型设定下，消费者对汽油税变动的反应都更为强烈，这一结论稳健。我们讨论了导致主要发现的两种可能原因，以及它们的含义。（JEL D12, H21, H25, H31, L71, Q35）

title: Getting Energy Prices Right: from Principle to Practice
How Should Different Countries Tax Fuels to Correct Environmental Externalities?
abstract: This essay discusses (based on a recent IMF study) how developed and developing countries alike might put into practice the principle of 'getting prices right' to address the major externalities from energy. The efficient set of taxes includes charges on fuel use for carbon and local pollution (with credits for emissions capture during combustion) and additional charges on motor fuels for road congestion and accidents (though the latter should transition to distance-based charges). Techniques and data sources for measuring the externalities and corrective taxes by country are discussed. In general, heavy taxes on coal and motor fuels are warranted (though there is substantial cross-country variation in corrective tax rates). For most countries, tax reform could yield considerable fiscal, health, and carbon benefits.
abstract_zh: 本文（基于国际货币基金组织近期的一项研究）探讨了发达国家与发展中国家如何共同践行“价格正确化”原则，以应对能源领域的主要外部性。有效的税收组合包括：针对碳排放和地方污染对燃料使用征收的费用（对燃烧过程中捕集的排放给予抵免），以及针对道路拥堵和交通事故对机动车燃料加征的附加费用（但后者应逐步过渡为按里程收费）。文中还讨论了按国家测算外部性和矫正性税率的方法与数据来源。总体而言，对煤炭和机动车燃料征收较重的税收是合理的（尽管各国矫正性税率存在较大差异）。对于大多数国家而言，税制改革可带来可观的财政、健康和碳减排效益。

title: On market dynamics of electric vehicle diffusion
venue: 52nd Annual Allerton Conference on Communication, Control, and Computing
abstract: A sequential game model is proposed to analyze a two-sided market and indirect network effects involving electrical vehicles (EV) and electric vehicle charging stations (EVCS). The investor maximizes his profit by choosing a set of locations to build charging stations or deferring his investment and earning interest at a fixed rate. The investor also decides the optimal pricing of charging. The consumer, on the other hand, decides whether to purchase an EV or a gasoline vehicle (GV) based on the price of EV, the cost of charging, and the availability of charging stations. The solution of the game provides a closed-form expression of the EV market share as a function of EV price, the price of charging, and the density of charging stations. An asymptotically optimal algorithm is proposed for solving the optimization of the investor's decision.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一个序贯博弈模型，用以分析涉及电动汽车（EV）与电动汽车充电站（EVCS）的双边市场及间接网络效应。投资者通过选择建设充电站的一组地点，或推迟投资并以固定利率获取利息，来实现利润最大化。投资者还决定充电的最优定价。另一方面，消费者则根据电动汽车价格、充电成本以及充电站的可得性，决定购买电动汽车还是燃油汽车（GV）。博弈的解给出了电动汽车市场份额的闭式表达式，该份额是电动汽车价格、充电价格和充电站密度的函数。本文还提出了一种渐近最优算法，用于求解投资者决策的优化问题。

title: Evaluating "Cash-for-Clunkers": Program Effects on Auto Sales and the Environment
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Firm Competitiveness and EU Emissions Trading System
How Important Are Endogenous Peer Effects in Group Lending? Estimating a Static Game
Cost-Effectiveness of Electricity Energy Efficiency Programs
abstract: We analyze the cost-effectiveness of electric utility ratepayer-fundedpro-grams to promote demand-side management (DSM) and energy efficiency (EE) investments. We specify a model that relates electricity demand to previous EE DSM spending, energy prices, income, weather, and other demand factors. In contrast to previous studies, we allow EE DSM spending to have a potential longterm demand effect and explicitly address possible endogeneity in spending. We find that current period EE DSM expenditures reduce electricity demand and that this effect persists for a number of years. Our findings suggest that ratepayer funded DSM expenditures between 1992 and 2006 produced a central estimate of 0.9 percent savings in electricity consumption over that time period and a 1.8 percent savings over all years. These energy savings came at an expected average cost to utilities of roughly 5 cents per kWh saved when future savings are discounted at a 5 percent rate.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了由电力公用事业用户付费资助的、旨在促进需求侧管理（DSM）和能效（EE）投资的项目的成本效益。我们设定了一个模型，将电力需求与此前的能效需求侧管理支出、能源价格、收入、天气以及其他需求因素联系起来。与以往研究不同，我们允许能效需求侧管理支出具有潜在的长期需求效应，并明确处理支出中可能存在的内生性问题。我们发现，当期的能效需求侧管理支出会减少电力需求，且这一效应可持续数年。我们的研究结果表明，1992至2006年间由用户付费资助的需求侧管理支出，在该时期内使电力消费的中心估计节约量为0.9%，在全部年份中则为1.8%。这些节能量的预期平均成本约为每节约一千瓦时5美分（按5%的贴现率对未来节约量进行贴现）。

title: Is There an Energy Paradox in Fuel Economy?
Traffic Safety and Vehicle Choice: Quantifying the Arms Race on American Roads
Gasoline Prices, Government Support, and the Demand for Hybrid Vehicles
abstract: We analyze the determinants in the demand for hybrid vehicles and examine government programs that aim to promote the adoption of these vehicles. We find that hybrid vehicle sales in 2006 would have been 37 percent lower had gasoline prices stayed at the 1999 levels while the effect of the federal income tax credit program is estimated at 20 percent in 2006. Our results suggest that under the income tax credit program, the cost of reducing gasoline consumption was $75 per barrel in government revenue and that of CO2 emission reduction was $177 per ton. We show that the cost-effectiveness of federal tax programs can be improved by adopting a flat rebate scheme.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了混合动力汽车需求的决定因素，并考察了旨在推动此类汽车普及的政府计划。我们发现，若汽油价格维持在1999年的水平，2006年混合动力汽车的销量将低37%；而联邦所得税抵免计划在2006年的效果估计为20%。我们的结果表明，在所得税抵免计划下，以政府收入计，每减少一桶汽油消费的成本为75美元，每减排一吨二氧化碳的成本为177美元。我们表明，采用统一定额返还的方式可以提高联邦税收计划的成本效益。

title: Lose Some, Save Some: Obesity, Automobile Demand, and Gasoline Consumption
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: How Do Gasoline Prices Affect Fleet Fuel Economy?
abstract: Exploiting a rich data set of passenger vehicle registrations in twenty U.S. metropolitan statistical areas from 1997 to 2005, we examine the effects of gasoline prices on the automotive fleet's composition. We find that high gasoline prices affect fleet fuel economy through two channels: (1) shifting new and purchases towards more fuel-efficient vehicles, and (2) speeding the scrappage of older, less fuel-efficient used vehicles. Policy simulations based on our econometric estimates suggest that a 10% increase in gasoline prices from 2005 levels will generate a 0.22% increase in fleet fuel economy in the short run and a 2.04% increase in the long run.
abstract_zh: 利用1997至2005年间美国20个大都市统计区内丰富的乘用车登记数据，我们考察了汽油价格对汽车车队构成的影响。我们发现，高油价通过两个渠道影响车队的燃油经济性：（1）推动新车购买转向更省油的车型；（2）加速报废较老、较耗油的二手车。基于我们计量估计结果的政策模拟表明，在2005年水平的基础上，汽油价格上涨10%，短期内将使车队燃油经济性提高0.22%，长期内则提高2.04%。

title: Attribute-Based Subsidies and Market Power: An Application to Electric Vehicles
abstract: Attribute-based subsidies (ABS) are commonly used to promote the diffusion of energy-efficient products, whose manufacturers often wield significant market power. We develop a theoretical framework for the optimal design of ABS to account for endogenous product attributes, environmental externalities, and market power. We then estimate an equilibrium model of China's vehicle market under ABS and conduct counterfactual simulations to evaluate the welfare impacts of various subsidy designs. Compared to the uniform subsidies, ABS lead to higher product quality and are more effective in mitigating quantity distortions, albeit with a modest environmental cost. Between 42% to 62% of welfare gains under ABS relative to uniform subsidies are attributed to more desirable product attributes, with the remainder explained by reductions in market power distortions. Allowing subsidy redistribution through product-level subsidies, as suggested by our theoretical model, further enhances welfare gains by an additional 34%to 62%.Among the ABS designs, China's notched subsidy design based on driving range leads to vehicle downsizing that undermines welfare benefits. Subsidies based on battery capacity, as implemented in the U.S., achieve the highest welfare gains by effectively balancing market power and environmental impacts.
abstract_zh: 基于属性的补贴（Attribute-based subsidies，ABS）常被用于推动节能产品的推广，而这类产品的制造商往往拥有显著的市场势力。我们构建了一个理论框架，用于在考虑内生产品属性、环境外部性和市场势力的情况下，设计最优的基于属性的补贴。随后，我们估计了中国汽车市场在基于属性补贴下的均衡模型，并进行反事实模拟，以评估不同补贴设计的福利影响。与统一补贴相比，基于属性的补贴带来更高的产品质量，并且在缓解数量扭曲方面更为有效，但会带来适度的环境成本。相对于统一补贴，基于属性补贴所带来的福利增益中，有42%至62%可归因于更理想的产品属性，其余部分则来自市场势力扭曲的减少。正如我们的理论模型所建议的，通过产品层面补贴进行补贴再分配，可使福利增益再额外提高34%至62%。在各种基于属性的补贴设计中，中国基于续航里程的分段式补贴设计导致车型小型化，削弱了福利收益。以电池容量为基础的补贴（美国曾实施的做法）通过有效平衡市场势力与环境影响，实现了最高的福利增益。

title: Drive Down the Cost: Learning by Doing and Government Policies in the Global EV Battery Industry
From Trade War to Green Transition: Optimal Electric Vehicle Tariffs with Revenue-Funded Subsidies
abstract: We study the optimal design of trade and industrial policy when governments pursue environmental objectives alongside traditional welfare goals. Motivated by the global transition to electric vehicles (EVs) and growing concerns about competitiveness, energy security, and climate change, we develop a framework in which policymakers choose tariffs and domestic production subsidies to maximize welfare, defined as the sum of consumer surplus, domestic profits, environmental benefits, and tariff revenue. We combine a theoretical model of differentiated-product oligopoly with a structural demand model estimated using vehicle-level data from 13 countries that together account for the vast majority of global EV sales. Our central finding is that the optimal policy combines a moderate tariff on imported EVs with a subsidy to domestic EV production financed through tariff revenue. This policy substantially outperforms both outright protectionism and laissez-faire. Relative to current policies, it preserves consumer access to affordable EVs, accelerates fleet electrification, supports domestic producers, and remains budget-neutral. For the United States, the optimal policy more than doubles EV market share, generates over $45 billion in annual welfare gains, and avoids approximately 95 million tons of lifetime CO2 emissions. A key mechanism underlying these results is the pass-through of tariffs and subsidies to prices, which depends critically on demand curvature, product substitution, and market structure. More broadly, our results suggest that effective industrial policy requires careful attention to market structure and country-specific conditions, balancing consumer, producer, fiscal, and environmental objectives rather than adhering to ideological prescriptions. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了当政府在追求传统福利目标的同时还追求环境目标时，贸易与产业政策的最优设计。受全球向电动汽车（EV）转型以及对竞争力、能源安全和气候变化日益关注的推动，我们构建了一个框架，在该框架中，政策制定者选择关税和国内生产补贴，以最大化福利，福利定义为消费者剩余、国内利润、环境效益与关税收入之和。我们将一个差异化产品寡头垄断的理论模型，与一个结构性需求模型相结合，后者利用来自13个国家的车辆层面数据进行估计，这13个国家合计占全球电动汽车销量的绝大部分。我们的核心发现是，最优政策将对进口电动汽车征收适度关税，与以关税收入为资金来源的国内电动汽车生产补贴相结合。这一政策大幅优于纯粹的保护主义和自由放任政策。相对于当前政策，它既能保障消费者获得价格可承受的电动汽车，又能加快车队电气化，支持国内生产商，并且在财政上保持收支平衡。对美国而言，最优政策可使电动汽车市场份额增长一倍以上，每年产生超过450亿美元的福利收益，并避免约9500万吨的终生二氧化碳排放。这些结果背后的一个关键机制，是关税和补贴向价格的传导，而这一传导关键取决于需求曲率、产品替代以及市场结构。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，有效的产业政策需要仔细关注市场结构和各国的具体条件，在消费者、生产者、财政与环境目标之间取得平衡，而不是固守意识形态的既定规定。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家居民，可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Climate Change and Market Power
Range Anxiety
Transportation Networks, Short-term Mobility, and Pollution Exposure: Evidence from High-Speed Rail
abstract: Can the enhanced mobility created by transportation infrastructure investments help people to avoid environmental extremes? We use transaction records from China’s card payment system to measure experienced pollution exposure (EPE)—that is, exposure based on the pollution levels at travelers’ actual locations—and evaluate how EPE was affected by the country’s high-speed railway network, even while holding pollution itself constant. Our estimates imply a reduction in EPE that corresponds to a mortality benefit of 21.3 million life-years saved, primarily due to travelers changing their destinations towards locations with predictably cleaner air.
abstract_zh: 交通基础设施投资所带来的更高流动性，能否帮助人们规避环境极端情况？我们利用中国银行卡支付系统的交易记录，衡量实际经历的污染暴露（EPE），即基于旅行者实际所在地污染水平的暴露程度，并在保持污染本身不变的情况下，评估全国高铁网络如何影响EPE。我们的估计表明，EPE的减少相当于挽救了2130万个生命年的死亡率收益，这主要是由于旅行者将目的地转向空气可预见性更清洁的地区。
